name: I-395 exit 4B ramp at Sutton Avenue: impassable
quote: In Oxford, the Sutton Avenue Exit (4B) off of I-395 was flooded with one foot of water and impassable.

name: I-290 eastbound exit ramp at Southbridge Street: flooded
quote: In the southern portion of Worcester, the Southbridge Street exit ramp off of I-290 eastbound had substantial flooding at the bottom of the ramp.
